import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']

for r in range(2, 7):
    ws.cell(r, 11).value = f'=INDEX($B$1:$H$1,MATCH(J{r},$C{r}:$I{r},0))'

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print("done")
